shared_constraints: Read this index once, then read each listed Action context by exact path; do not rediscover context from generated trees.
Edit only project-owned Action source and paired tests; never edit generated source, manifests, receipts, caches, or managed Runtime state.

Read verification.path during apply, copy verification.harness_template into project-owned business-flow tests, and read only the hash-checked shards listed by verification.minimum_read_plan before apply finalize.
Use the delivery build constraint and the complete hermetic Go environment with project-local-plus-public GOPROXY exactly as shown; never inherit host GOPRIVATE or GONOPROXY.

Consume every call outcome: never discard all returns or an error/ok result with the blank identifier, including in local helpers. A data return may be ignored only while a sibling error is bound and handled; the focused command runs project check, which reuses the finalizer's exact read-only project-source validation after Go tests.

stage_boundary.post_apply_repair: If implementation or black-box test design proves the authored Action surface cannot establish a required state, repair the Blueprint, run model plan, then apply model. state=evolution_review_required with exit 0 is a non-terminal review control state, not materialization success: inspect the exact audit path/SHA and rerun next_command with a non-empty reviewed reason. Continue implementation only after state=implementation_ready or state=applied.
stage_boundary.before_finalize: Complete all Handler, paired test, and required backend/tests/businessflow source; run focused, which includes the finalizer's exact read-only project-source check after Go tests, and business_flow_compile. Do not run the full tree because generated composition may intentionally be incomplete.
stage_boundary.finalize: After all project-owned source and pre-finalize tests are complete, run apply finalize exactly once.
stage_boundary.after_finalize: Project-owned source is frozen. Run the full backend tree and verify without source edits. Any source change starts a new repair iteration and requires focused tests plus apply finalize again before verify.
